evidenceBoundary.source: EvidenceFlow no-value provider handoffs plus existing non-sensitive repository-governance evidence
allowedRecordTypes: controlled equality boolean or enumerated state
bounded usage-review result and explicit interpretation limit

postReceiptCorrections.interpretation: Additive no-value secret-store scope correction; it does not change provider revocation facts or overall containment state.

followUpReadbacks.interpretation: Fresh read-only continuity evidence for the six remaining provider rows; it performed no containment write, closes no provider row, and cannot activate contaminated-ref deletion.

secretStoreReadinessReceipts.interpretation: Non-exhaustive readiness and dependency inventory only; independent source review found an additional Qwen probe consumer not listed in the fixed receipt. It does not prove creation, rotation, revocation, deployed consumption, or provider containment.

blockerReceipts.interpretation: Timestamped fail-closed provider/Git baseline. It does not prevent governance-only preservation progress, but old PR checks do not cover the then-uncommitted A01 changes and it cannot authorize merge, deletion, root movement, or feature thaw.

privateTransport.interpretation: Non-sensitive transport-mechanism probe only; it does not prove real credential transfer, provider creation, secret-store update, runtime binding, or deployment.

preActionReadinessReceipts.interpretation: Pre-action UI and transport-mechanism readiness only. No replacement, rotation, secret-store write, usage closure, revocation, deployment, provider containment, PR readiness, merge, or remote-ref deletion is proved or authorized.

rotationCloseoutReceipts.usageReviewBoundary: default-view-no-visible-data-with-approximately-one-hour-reporting-delay; no claim about historical, delayed, or other-window usage

configuredAboutReadback.interpretation: The redirect occurred before an authentication result; the probes cannot distinguish legacy from replacement authentication state.

rotationCloseoutReceipts.usageReviewBoundary: key-level usage unavailable in the safe authorized surface; no real-user xAPI analytics read and no zero-usage claim

secondaryExposure.interpretation: Provider-side deletion contains the old shared credential object but does not erase the prior username-only diagnostic disclosure or prove absence from other artifacts.

evidenceFlowCorrections.resendOld403Interpretation: indeterminate because a sending-only key cannot call the management API
